title: Muscle-synergy extraction on GRABMyo: high-VAF and reproducible across data halves

dataset.name: GRABMyo
dataset.citation: Pradhan A, He J, Jiang N. Multi-day dataset of forearm and wrist electromyogram for hand gesture recognition and biometrics. Sci Data. 2022;9:733. Goldberger AL, et al. PhysioNet. Circulation. 2000;101(23):e215-20.

proposition: Non-negative matrix factorisation of real GRABMyo forearm EMG yields high-quality muscle synergies (4-synergy VAF = 0.982; a 2-synergy solution already clears VAF >= 0.90) whose weights reproduce across independent data halves - all four synergies with best-matched correlations 0.85-0.98 and a pooled ICC(A,1) of 0.89 (95% CI 0.82-0.94) under a robust best-of-restarts NMF.

claims.statement: pooled split-half reliability, ICC(A,1) over the synergy weights
lower 95% CI bound of the pooled ICC
weakest best-matched split-half correlation (all four synergies reproduce)

validation.reference: split-half reproducibility of the synergy weight vectors on the real signal, quantified by best-matched correlation and by the intraclass correlation coefficient ICC(A,1) (two-way random, absolute agreement; McGraw & Wong 1996)
validation.note: NMF is the appropriate non-negative model for surface-EMG synergies. Reliability is estimated with a robust best-of-restarts NMF (20 restarts, fixed seed): all four synergies reproduce across the halves (best-matched r 0.85-0.98) with a pooled ICC(A,1) of 0.89 (95% CI 0.82-0.94), good-to-excellent agreement. A single-run NMF instead gives unstable split-half correlations (a weak-looking fourth synergy is an initialisation artifact of non-convex optimisation, not real over-extraction); parsimony - the two-synergy VAF>=0.90 knee - is the basis for preferring fewer synergies.

open_questions.q: Fitting four synergies over-extracts past the two-synergy VAF>=0.90 optimum (parsimony), but the four-synergy weights are still reproducible across halves with a robust best-of-restarts NMF (pooled ICC 0.89). The 'weak fourth synergy' seen with a single-run NMF is an initialisation artifact, not an instability of the structure. Documented, not escalated.
